name: Amami Shiori
source:
A little airhead at times, but has a strong willed personality. Her husband died shortly after she gave birth to their son Hiroki, so she raised him on her own.

She's indulgent and strict at the same time to Hiroki, and is a good mother to him. She hasn't dated anyone other than her husband, so she relieves herself only through masturbation. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.appetite-game.com/apt_010.html#char]Official Site[/url]]
